title: bot.behavior.change
description: Change an existing behavior. Select names it and says what changes (intent only); the builder then revises its SCXML program from the intent, the existing program and this turn. Changing a persistent routine (for example its schedule) restarts it with the revised program, and a change may also turn a behavior into a routine or back.

name.description: Stable name of the behavior to revise.
name.title: Name

triggers.description: Replacement stimulus event names whose turns this behavior answers (a turn behavior); a routine needs none.
triggers.title: Triggers

description.description: Revised human-readable summary of what the behavior does, shown in inventory and reflection. The install keeps the caller-supplied description when present.
examples: Say hello when a knock sound arrives, after clearing focus.
description.title: Description

reason.description: Why this behavior is being revised now: the observed gap or regression the revision fixes. Recorded for reflection, never dispatched.
reason.title: Reason

example.description: For a turn behavior: one message the behavior must answer, written as the user would say it (for 'when I say ping, say pong': ping). The behavior is run on it before it is accepted and must handle it. Null for a routine.
example.title: Example

source.description: Leave null: the builder writes the revised program.
source.title: Source
